28903-all-that-matters.title: All That Matters
28903-all-that-matters.creator: Edgar A. Guest
28903-all-that-matters.description: A book by Edgar A. Guest. When all that matters shall be written down And the long record of our years is told, Where sham, like flesh, must perish and grow cold; When the tomb closes on our fair renown And priest and layman, sage and motleyed clown Must quit the places which they dearly hold, What to our credit shall we find enscrolled?

arxiv-2203-14234.title: Making a case for femto- phono- magnetism with FePt
arxiv-2203-14234.creator: S. Sharma, S. Shallcross, P. Elliott, J. K. Dewhurst
arxiv-2203-14234.description: Abstract In the field of femtomagnetism magnetic matter is controlled by ultrafast laser pulses; here we show that coupling phonon excitations of the nuclei to spin and charge leads to femto-phono-magnetism, a powerful route to control magnetic order at ultrafast times.

arxiv-2211-05350.title: The entropy rate of Linear Additive Markov Processes
arxiv-2211-05350.creator: Bridget Smart, Matthew Roughan, Lewis Mitchell
arxiv-2211-05350.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bridget Smart, Matthew Roughan, Lewis Mitchell. I Abstract This work derives a theoretical value for the entropy of a Linear Additive Markov Process (LAMP), an expressive model able to generate sequences with a given autocorrelation structure. While a first-order Markov Chain model generates new values by conditioning on the current state, the LAMP model takes the transition state from the sequence’s history according to some distribution which does not have to be bounded.

arxiv-2308-13152.title: The time dimensional reduction method to determine the initial conditions without the knowledge of damping coefficients
arxiv-2308-13152.creator: Thuy T. Le, Linh V. Nguyen, Loc H. Nguyen, Hyunha Park
arxiv-2308-13152.description: Abstract This paper aims to reconstruct the initial condition of a hyperbolic equation with an unknown damping coefficient. Our approach involves approximating the hyperbolic equation’s solution by its truncated Fourier expansion in the time domain and using a polynomial-exponential basis. This truncation process facilitates the elimination of the time variable, consequently, yielding a system of quasi-linear elliptic equations.

arxiv-2402-08399.title: Deep Learning-based Real-time Smartphone Pose Detection for Ultra-wideband Tagless Gate
arxiv-2402-08399.creator: Junyoung Choi, Sagnik Bhattacharya
arxiv-2402-08399.description: Abstract As commercial interest in proximity services increased, the development of various wireless localization techniques was promoted. In line with this trend, Ultra-wideband (UWB) is emerging as a promising solution that can realize proximity services thanks to centimeter-level localization accuracy.

arxiv-2406-07417.title: Average-exact mixed anomalies and compatible phases
arxiv-2406-07417.creator: Yichen Xu, Chao-Ming Jian
arxiv-2406-07417.description: Abstract The quantum anomaly of a global symmetry is known to strongly constrain the allowed low-energy physics in a clean and isolated quantum system. However, the effect of quantum anomalies in disordered systems is much less understood, especially when the global symmetry is only preserved on average by the disorder.

arxiv-2411-08940.title: X-ray measurements of gas distribution in a zero gap alkaline water electrolyzer
arxiv-2411-08940.creator: On-Yu Dung, Stephan Boden, Albertus W. Vreman, Niels G. Deen, Markus Schubert, Yali Tang
arxiv-2411-08940.description: Abstract X-ray radioscopy was used to measure the 2D projected dynamic void fraction in a zero/narrow gap alkaline water electrolyzer at a spatial resolution of 15 μ \mu m, for narrow gap sizes up to 300 μ \mu m and current densities up to 0.54 A/cm 2 .

arxiv-2508-16218.title: Hybrid Precoding Revisited: Low-Dimensional Subspace Perspective for MU-MIMO Systems
arxiv-2508-16218.creator: Mintaek Oh, Jinseok Choi
arxiv-2508-16218.description: Abstract This letter presents a low-complexity hybrid precoding framework for multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems by leveraging a low-dimensional subspace property. Under the low-dimensional subspace perspective, we first identify an unconstrained optimal radio-frequency (RF) precoder. We then optimize a hybrid precoder via a reduced-complexity precoding method.

pmc-10564792.title: The increase in the surface brightness of the night sky and its importance in visual astronomical observations
pmc-10564792.creator: Marcin Wesołowski
pmc-10564792.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The problem of sky pollution with artificial light currently affects practically all branches that are related to the broadly understood environment. This is especially true for astronomical observations. This paper presents the results of measurements of the surface brightness of the night sky for the city of Rzeszów and the surrounding area, which were made in 2015, 2018 and 2021 using the photometer Sky Quality Meter (SQM-L).

pmc-10594247.title: An infection prevention and control program established in the wake of the Ebola epidemic: Where are we, and how well are we doing?
pmc-10594247.creator: Bobson Fofanah, Christiana Conteh, Victoria Katawera, Ibrahim Franklyn Kamara
pmc-10594247.description: Background: Infection prevention and control (IPC) is a clinical and public health discipline based on a scientific approach and practical preventive and control measures. During the 2014–2016 West African Ebola outbreak, the high number of healthcare worker infections was attributed to inadequate IPC in Sierra Leone. This stimulated the establishment of national and subnational IPC programs.

pmc-11334800.title: Water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) index for primary healthcare facilities: Towards achieving WASH security
pmc-11334800.creator: Enovwo E. Odjegba, Abayomi O. Bankole, Adebayo Sadiq, Barakat O. Layi-Adigun, Abayomi M. Adebimpe, Mariam O. Kosemani, Emmanuel B. Ojo, Mustapha A. Adewuyi
pmc-11334800.description: This study focused on designing a WASH Index for assessing the status of WASH in Primary Healthcare Facilities (PHCs) especially for low- and middle-income countries. To assess the effectiveness of the WASH Index in evaluating the WASH in PHCs, PHCs were selected from 70 Local Government Areas (LGA) across 3 Southwestern States in Nigeria.

pmc-11666637.title: The impact of environmental regulations on carbon emissions in countries with different levels of emissions
pmc-11666637.creator: Justyna Borowiec, Monika Papież, Sławomir Śmiech
pmc-11666637.description: The study analyzes the impact of environmental regulations on carbon emissions in countries with different levels of emissions, utilizing two measures of carbon emissions based on: production (PBA) and consumption (CBA) accounting. Environmental regulations are measured by means of three components of the Environmental Policy Stringency (EPS) index: market-based and non-market-based instruments, and technology support.

pmc-12467297.title: Integrative Analysis of Transcriptomics and Metabolomics Reveals the Effects of Western-Style Diets on Spleen Function
pmc-12467297.creator: Shengguo Tang, Dongfang Li, Yanna Ma, Zhiying Zhao, Liangyuan Peng, Shuchao Liao, Haiming Ma, Hongjiang Wei
pmc-12467297.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigated the effects of a high-fat diet (HFD) on spleen function in C57BL/6 mice. Mice fed an HFD showed increased body weight and spleen index compared to the standard chow (CHFD) group. Histological analysis revealed structural damage in HFD spleens.

pmc-12553222.title: Menstrual-related symptoms and absence from school among young people in Sweden: a stratified, randomized, population-based survey
pmc-12553222.creator: Klara Abrahamsson, Eva Åkerman, Sara Ström, Lisa Söderman, Henrik Källberg, Marie Klingberg-Allvin
pmc-12553222.description: BackgroundMenstrual-related symptoms such as menstrual pain and heavy bleeding impact individuals’ health, quality of life and can limit the ability to engage in daily life activities, including school. Menstrual-related symptoms thus risk reinforcing existing gender inequalities in health among young people, making it an issue of equal rights and public health concerns.

pmc-12781371.title: Periostin as a diagnostic marker and therapeutic target for intervertebral disc degeneration
pmc-12781371.creator: Yao Yuan, Mengping Xu, Tian Qin, Heng Sun, Jianhua Sun
pmc-12781371.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The pathophysiology of intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD), a condition associated with significant morbidity, remains incompletely elucidated. Identification of key proteins that drive IDD progression is crucial for developing effective strategies to mitigate disease advancement. In this study, we discovered that periostin (POSTN) play an important role in IDD through the bioinformatic analysis, and confirmed its presentation in patient nucleus pulposus (NP) tissues and serum samples. Additionally, the serum POSTN level is positively correlated with IDD.

pmc-12915048.title: Subcellular thiol functional group distribution in Geobacter sulfurreducens determined by Hg LIII-edge EXAFS
pmc-12915048.creator: Fanchao Meng, Ulf Skyllberg, Yangyang Li, Shusaku Hayama, Erik Björn, Yu Song
pmc-12915048.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Mercury (Hg) is a global environmental concern due to its microbial conversion to methylmercury (MeHg), a potent neurotoxin that bioaccumulates in food webs and poses risks to ecosystems and human health. Thiol functional groups (RSH) play an important role in controlling Hg(II) speciation and bio-uptake in methylating bacteria, yet the spatial distribution and density of these thiols within cells remain largely unknown.

pmc-13045029.title: Not racemic after all: stereochemical composition of a commercially available sodium lactate solution
pmc-13045029.creator: Mette Glavind Bülow Pedersen, Robert Andrew Robergs, Kristoffer Berg-Hansen, Esben Søndergaard, Niels Møller, Nikolaj Rittig
pmc-13045029.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). orm derived from glycolysis, and D-lactate. In humans, D-lactate is generated in vivo through methylglyoxal detoxification and circulates at systemic concentrations that represent only a very small fraction of the L-lactate enantiomer [1]. Hypertonic sodium lactate (HSL) therapy has shown potential in neurology and cardiology, yet most clinical studies do not disclose the lactate enantiomer composition of exogenous lactate therapies [1]. In a recent publication in Critical Care, our group reported beneficial cardiovascular effects of a commercially available HSL compound [2].

pmc-13206853.title: Silkworm SOCS2 Differentially Promotes Multiple Steps of BmNPV Proliferation and Modulates the mRNA Expression of SOCS-STAT Network Components
pmc-13206853.creator: Cong Zhang, Hengchuan Xia, Qianzhu Wan, Yangyang Chen, Gaoying Xu, Jingao Wang, Liang Chen, Jin Wang, Keping Chen
pmc-13206853.description: Simple SummarySilkworms are an important economic insect, but they are often infected by a virus called BmNPV, causing serious losses to sericulture. In this study, we discovered that a host factor, suppressor of cytokine signaling 2 (SOCS2), which normally negatively regulates immune responses, can be exploited by the virus to promote its own replication.

pmc-13369659.creator: Nick M. Murray, Bart M. Demaerschalk, Caitlin S. Brown, Ira Chang, Gabriel V. Fontaine, William David Freeman, Raimund Helbok, Meghan A. Knoedler, Christopher L. pmc-13369659.description: Background and PurposeTeleneurocritical care (TeleNCC) provides virtual neurocritical care in emergency departments and intensive care units that do not have continuous in-person coverage. However, there is limited evidence upon which to apply standards, benchmarks, and best practice. The scope of TeleNCC practice is beyond that of Telestroke and Telecritical Care, both of which have existing guidelines.

pmc-13587077.title: Reconstruction of fat crystal organization by a phytosterol/γ-oryzanol bigel: Linking structural evolution in blended fat systems to dough architecture and cookie quality
pmc-13587077.creator: Yuanyuan Peng, Ke Zhou, Lijuan Han, Yan Yang, Junbo He, Chen Chen, Pei Liu, Jiangtao Feng
